subject: Television & Streaming
title: Buffy Summers: The Slayer Who Changed TV
description: A quick, practical guide to Buffy Summers: The Slayer Who Changed TV.

hook.text: A blonde teenage girl kills vampires after school.

buildup.text: Joss Whedon created Buffy as the girl who fights back. High school was the real monster—vampires were just the metaphor.

discovery.text: The show blended horror, comedy, and genuine emotional depth.

twist.text: Buffy influenced an entire generation of female action characters.

climax.text: Buffy proved genre television could be serious art.

punchline.text: A vampire show about high school became a template for modern TV.

quiz.question: What horror cliché did Buffy the Vampire Slayer deliberately subvert?
options: The helpless blonde woman victim—Buffy was the one who fights back
